lossback.subject: Keep the thick, bevelled neon-lime circular 're-roll' arrow from the approved design exactly as it is (same shape, colour, thickness, bevel and counter-clockwise loop, passing in front of and behind the centre object). REPLACE the white die in the middle with a SMALL, thick Goated gold coin embossed with the Goated ram-horn glyph (exactly as on the coin reference), standing upright and slightly turned in a 3/4 view. The coin is small relative to the arrow loop, leaving clear space between them. There are no dice anywhere in the image.
lossback.notes: Remove the die completely; the only objects are the lime circular arrow and one small Goated coin.

tierup.subject: Keep the Goated rocket from the approved design exactly as it is (chunky deep slate-navy body, neon-lime nose cone and fins, launching diagonally up-right with a golden flame and small sparks touching the flame). REMOVE every gem and VIP tier icon: the round porthole is plain, glossy blue-tinted glass with a light-grey steel rim and a white highlight, and there is nothing in the flame trail except fire and sparks. No gems, no tier emblems, no coins, no other objects.
tierup.notes: Remove the diamond in the porthole and the sapphire and emerald in the flame trail.

freespins.notes: The three red '7' numerals on the reels are part of the design and must stay; no other text or numbers. No coins.
